content.text:
Is It Too Late To Buy Micron Stock After Its Record Memory Run?: The article presents its own valuation analysis and reported performance figures, summarizes Micron’s strategic customer agreement (SCA) terms, and notes the scheduled September 30 FY2026 Q4 results. Its contract description is commentary on previously disclosed terms, not a new company announcement. (time=2026-09-23T13:01:32Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Micron Fiscal Q3 2026 Earnings Call Prepared Remarks: Micron described typical SCA terms as five years, from calendar 2026 through the end of calendar 2030. The remarks also discuss the expected revenue share of agreements with fixed prices or price ceilings, subject to planned agreements being executed. (time=2026-06-24; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Micron Technology to Report Fiscal Fourth Quarter Results on September 30, 2026: Micron announced its fiscal Q4 earnings call for September 30, 2026, at 2:30 p.m. Mountain time. This confirms the date cited by Trefis, not the eventual results. (time=2026-08-26T16:01:00-04:00; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Micron inks long-term supply agreements worth $100 billion — says it has no idea when RAM crisis will end: The report covered Micron’s 16 SCAs, including approximately $100 billion in minimum-price contract revenue across 14 agreements and $22 billion in customer deposits and related financial commitments. It described typical five-year terms through 2030, with automotive agreements as an exception, and referenced contracted DRAM and NAND volumes. (time=2026-06-25; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).

Micron Q3 2026 earnings call 40% revenue strategic customer agreements term 2030 June 25 2026 official transcript
Micron FY2026 Q3 guidance revenue 50 billion September 30 earnings date June 25 2026 investor release

content.text:
Q3 2026 Earnings Deck — Business Model Transformation and Strategic Customer Agreements: Micron described SCAs as take-or-pay agreements with binding volume commitments. It said the largest agreements generally have ceilings for existing products near calendar Q2 2026 market prices and floors through the agreement term. Once planned SCAs were executed, fixed-price or near-current-Q2-ceiling agreements were expected to cover about 40% of revenue; total SCA coverage was described more broadly as about half or more of revenue. (time=2026-06-24; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Micron Technology, Inc. Reports Record Results for the Third Quarter of Fiscal 2026: Micron reported Q3 FY2026 revenue of $41.456 billion and guided Q4 revenue to $50.0 billion ± $1.0 billion. It also said HBM4 was in high-volume shipments for its lead customer’s platform, with qualification samples sent to multiple end customers. (time=2026-06-24; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Acer CEO says memory makers are hyping 2030 shortage fears to protect margins — PC prices set to decline by late 2027: Reporting Jason Chen’s comments via DigiTimes, the article says Acer’s CEO viewed broad memory supply as ample apart from high-end DDR5, expected Chinese suppliers to add pricing pressure, and forecast PC-price declines in the latter half of 2027. These are attributed views, not measured industry supply data. (time=2026-09-21; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
